description: Finds Platinumride private transfer routes between Gulf cities. Accepts full sentences (e.g. 'Dubai to Muscat with kids'), city names, country names (e.g. Oman, Saudi Arabia), airport names and IATA codes, Arabic names and common typos. Returns indicative per-vehicle 'from' prices in local currency and approximate AED, travel time, distance, border crossings and booking links. Unmatched queries return an empty route list with suggestions.

from.description: Origin city, airport code or Arabic name, e.g. 'Dubai', 'DXB', 'دبي'.

internationalOnly.description: Whether results are limited to routes with a border crossing.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

q.description: Free-text origin and destination query, a full sentence is fine, e.g. 'Dubai to Muscat with kids', 'Dubai airport to Oman' or 'دبي إلى الرياض'.

to.description: Destination city, airport code or Arabic name, e.g. 'Muscat', 'MCT'.

name: search_routes
title: Search transfer routes
